title: [AAFLOW+] Stateful Operator Abstraction with Zero-Copy Distributed KV Cache Orchestration for Multi-Agent Workflows
selection_reason: AAFLOW+ treats distributed KV cache as a first-class systems object with materialization, transfer, fork, composition, eviction, and zero-copy execution, making it directly relevant to KV reuse and distributed inference systems.
